source_excerpt: | `save_text_memories` | Boolean | Defaults to `false`. When set to `true`, SQL Lens can save its own free-form notes about your schema to memory. When off, SQL Lens writes no notes of its own — a wrong guess cannot become a lasting note — while notes already in memory, including ones you imported, are kept and still used as background context. The environment override is `SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_TEXT_MEMORIES`; an empty or whitespace-only value counts as off.

source_excerpt: It is registered **only when `cfg.memory.save_text_memories` is true** (it defaults to `false`, issue #267): an agent-written note is trusted context on every later question, so a wrong guess would persist unasked.
